title: 1963. Minimum Number of Swaps to Make the String Balanced

examples.explanation: You can make the string balanced by swapping index 0 with index 3. The resulting string is "[[]]".
You can do the following to make the string balanced: - Swap index 0 with index 4. s = "[]][][". - Swap index 1 with index 5. s = "[[][]]". The resulting string is "[[][]]".
